description: Change artboards: set name, position, size, background colour and auto-nesting (Properties panel), duplicate one, ungroup them back to layers (Layer > Ungroup Artboards), clear their guides (View > Guides > Clear Selected Artboard Guides), add guides from a shape (New Artboard Guides From Shape), or pick the Artboard or Frame tool

autoNest.description: set: let layers moved onto or off the artboard nest into or out of it automatically (false prevents auto-nesting)

target.description: The artboards (ids from get_artboards); for guides_from_shape, the shape layer

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

tool.description: select_tool: the Artboard tool or the Frame tool

x.description: set, duplicate: left edge in pixels

y.description: set, duplicate: top edge in pixels

name: edit_artboards
title: Edit Artboards
